development_split.method: first seeded 25%-cluster split with >=2 positive/negative clusters per class in both partitions

content.reason_scope: Authoritatively confirmed source unavailability only. No intensity or model-prediction based exclusions. No sample replacement or replenishment. Original intake failure remains unchanged.

metadata.cleaning_rules: observed preferred within transition; Ritz fallback; exact duplicates removed; raw fields preserved
metadata.notice: NIST atomic lines are reference data, not measured mixture spectra. Relative intensities from different elements are not concentration calibration.

source.license_basis: NASA explicit us-pd; DATA_SET_ID must match each PDS label.
source.wavelength_method_evidence: Clegg2017 wavelength calibration section: Ti baseline wavelength-channel map uses known vacuum lines and spectra are resampled to that map. Gasda2021 sections2.1/2.3.1 identify the same LANL testbed and Ti calibration before each laboratory sample run, citing Clegg2017. CALINFO links calib_2015 and calib_2021 to those methods. Medium is based on this method chain, not chamber pressure.
source.composition_evidence: Clegg2017 standard provenance: independent XRF/dry combustion or certified values; missing values are not zero. Gasda2021 section2.2: commercial reference standards or independent ACTLabs fusion ICP-MS. Values are published assay estimates, not certified per-cell upper bounds.

selection.threshold_rule: unique known tuning scores plus nextafter(max,+inf); maximize physical recall subject to point FPR<=0.05; tie lower FPR then higher threshold
selection.model_rule: maximum tuning macro balanced accuracy; tie smaller C; no refit on tune
selection.baseline: fixed NIST neutral NNLS with thresholds selected on identical real tuning set
selection.primary_comparison: adapted logistic minus threshold-adapted NNLS on the untouched final campaign

limitations: Published assays lack per-cell uncertainty; guarded labels do not certify absence.
LANL testbed profile only; not validated for another instrument or Mars measurements.
No blank experiment, H/He validation, probability calibration or concentration fit.
Split uses metadata and compositions; no intensity or model result selects it.
